bodyHtml:
What This Is

Real-time, always-on payment settlement infrastructure (PIX, Bizum, UPI, FedNow) projected to handle 22% of all non-cash global transactions by 2028.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Instant payments to account for 22% of all global non-cash transactions by 2028. PIX: 170M users, BRL 11T in 2024. Bizum: 30M users, 4.2B transactions, 90K retailers. Getnet 2026.

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Early Commercial
Confidence Level Confirmed
Confidence Score +0.88
Estimated Deployment Ongoing / Deployed
Horizon Deployed
Independent Sources Tracked 1

What This Enables

Advancement here directly benefits or unblocks:

  • Embedded Finance

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
